notes.title: Sexena: HOTFIX
notes.content:
Howdy everyone! We've got a small release of some new features and fixes- nothing major enough to warrant a full update, but enough to hopefully fix some issues that some of you may be having!

- Issues with the game end soft locking for some people. Should be able to experience the whole game.
- Troll fight pose no longer missing.
- Reset fixed to properly reset game.
- Hiccup in game flow forcing player to click next arrow on unlocking previously unlocked achievements fixed
- Mute button

notes.title: ANIMATION UPDATE
notes.content:
The feature list might not be long on this update- but that doesn't mean this update isn't a game changer! On top of some additional quality of life fixes, we've gone ahead and added fully animated idle poses to each of the main monster competitors! (and guest character, Tamani)

Currently you can only see the new animation idles by starting a game- older saves aren't properly showing the animations, /yet/. We're working on a hotfix in the next couple of days to have older saves show the updated animations soon- but still, why not take the time to dive into the game from the beginning again to check out the new stuff early? (there may also be some issues with rats idle, which we're looking into)

Additionally, the game is on sale for Valentine's Day + Lunar New Years, until the 19th! Pick it up for yourself or for a friend during this time! If you're interested in adult games, check out our full catalog of TinyHat Published games!

[list]
[*] Animated poses (for idle stance only) for monsters and Tamani (fresh saves only, for the time being)
[*] Save\Load\Restart\Quit Menu overhaul (there are some significant changes here)
[/list]

notes.title: FULLSCREEN UPDATE
notes.content:
We weren't able to get this one out in the last patch- but we wanted to make sure we could get this out before the next big patch! So here's an in-between quality of life hotfix of sorts.


CHANGES
[list]
[*] Full Screen Support!
[*] Multiple Resolution Support! (UI Scaling)
[/list]

notes.title: GALLERY UPDATE
notes.content:
We've listened to your feedback and we've been hard at work addressing it! Many of you asked for features such as a gallery, more options, & various quality of life tweaks- we're happy to announce that we have those in now!

We've tested save compatibility and old save files should work and appropriately update- let us know if there are any issue there though!


CHANGES
[list]
[*] Gallery Mode
[*] Sound Controls
[*] Achievement popups
[*] 6 More save slots
[*] Increased text and choice display speed
[*] Increased text speed
[*] Additional save files
[/list]

FIXES
[list]
[*] Minor graphical fixes
[*] Fixed various typos and text issues
[*] Fixed text errors
[/list]
